payload.title: Review Brief: Check for Updates Synchronization Mechanism
payload.summary: Codex PR #12 has been merged into main. CA3 reviewed the actual implementation files and tests. The delivery satisfies WP-0012 at the implementation level and should advance to live operational validation.
payload.review_subject: PR #12 — Implement Check for Updates synchronization mechanism
implementation_summary: Added src/estate/core/check_updates.py as the local-first actor-aware synchronization briefing generator.
Registered check-updates CLI command in src/estate/cli/main.py with --actor and --json support.
ca3_findings: The implementation treats Check for Updates as a pointer mechanism, not onboarding and not a fixed universal checklist.
The implementation explicitly avoids creating governance, security clearance policy, lifecycle states, offices, or a new mailbox identity system.
Actor normalization covers Chief Architects, Alfred, Audit, Implementation/Codex, Documentation, Discovery, Steward, and General actors.
The placeholder visibility model uses public, estate_internal, and restricted and is documented as non-authoritative.
The command scans ADRs, governance docs, collaboration docs, operations docs, messages, status files, runtime reports, and institutional memory.
Assigned messages are surfaced by matching destination against the normalized actor or actor family.
Missing inputs and malformed JSON/JSONL become warnings instead of fatal errors.
lifecycle_assessment: Check for Updates Synchronization Mechanism should be treated as Implemented.
Operational validation remains pending until it is used live by Chief Architects, Alfred, implementation workers, audit workers, and Steward-facing review.
The visibility placeholder must not become de facto security policy before HR/security governance matures.
requested_ca2_review: Confirm whether the actor categories are sufficient for the current Estate.
Review whether the placeholder visibility model is conservative enough without pretending to be final clearance policy.
Recommend whether Check for Updates should become an operational standard immediately or remain in validation first.
Review the related Parking Lot item PL-0011: Mailbox Synchronization Duty Standard.
